q1.note: both put >= 50% on training: on CLEAN input, training carries most of the readable signal in both a generative and a non-generative encoder. Whatever makes the share drop below 50% elsewhere, it is not 'generative training' and not 'clean input'

comparability: D1 is NOT numerically comparable to E8's D1: E8 reads a noised latent at t=600, this reads clean video, and the floor definition differs (permutation within scenes here, seed-spread there). D2 IS comparable — it depends only on the perturbation and the readout.
floor_definition: permutation within scenes (PREREG.md D4 definition B)
note: Geometry is the model's own (256x256, 64 frames) because the position encoding is built for it; that is a smaller field of view than E8's 512, so AUC_real here is not the same quantity as E8's even before the noising difference.

scale_axis.note: larger model is weaker: the difference is 6.5x the larger perm floor (0.0167)
